boundaries: package.json, its lockfile and the folders are there; runtime/mod.ts does not re-export test.ts (FR-001 is also held by the layout the other tests import from)
the kernel type-checks with no host types; boundaries.test.ts: the kernel imports nothing outside kernel/ and names no host global
boundaries.test.ts: the runtime imports only node: builtins, kernel/ and runtime/
boundaries.test.ts: no Deno, Bun, jsr:, npm:, @std, @erga or URL import in code, with negative controls; tsc fails on a Deno reference (types: node)
kernel/result.test.ts and text.test.ts: Result's helpers, absurd with a switch that leaves an alternative out, brands kept apart
kernel/decode.test.ts: each decoder, its error path and the JSON round trip
kernel/semver.test.ts: semver.org's example order, round trip, order laws, bumps, dotted versions
kernel/sha256.test.ts: FIPS 180-2 vectors, hexadecimal round trip, the brand, SHASUMS files
kernel/text.test.ts: lf, plain, splitArgs and quoteArgs, and their round trip
kernel/archive.test.ts: round trips of tar, zip and gzip, fixed bytes, unsafe and damaged archives, deflated zip, pax and GNU names
kernel/text.test.ts: literals written and read back, keys, comments, refusals
kernel/http.test.ts: Link headers, Retry-After in both forms, safe methods
runtime/test.test.ts: the assertions and proves; the same tests pass under deno test, node --test and bun test in CI
the type-level tests (expectType, @ts-expect-error) with their negative controls compile; the laws are property-tested with fast-check in the kernel tests
boundaries.test.ts: every file has an @module block and every export has JSDoc
boundaries.test.ts: the development dependencies are exact, the lockfile agrees, no run-time dependency
tsc 7 with the strict configuration on every file; boundaries.test.ts checks that TypeScript is 7
the CI matrix: tsc 7 on both configurations, the suite on Deno, Node 26 and Bun, on Linux, macOS and Windows
runtime/fs.test.ts: each Node error code becomes its class with code, path and cause; NotFound, AlreadyExists, IsADirectory, AddrInUse are thrown where the host refuses
runtime/fs.test.ts: every call on a real temporary folder, the refusals, Stolos's helpers
runtime/proc.test.ts: both platforms' rules and file URLs
runtime/proc.test.ts: the environment, the platform's names, which, a program with its input and output, lines, NotFound, abort
runtime/net.test.ts: the look for each environment, terminal detection, raw mode refused without a terminal
runtime/net.test.ts: classification, waits, Retry-After, retries against a local server, resume with Range, the SHA-256 check
runtime/net.test.ts: a real server on a free port: bodies, cookies, HEAD, a handler that throws, AddrInUse, shutdown by signal
the jobs take Bun's version from commons/generated/pins.auto.env; boundaries.test.ts: no npm, Prettier, ESLint, dprint or Vitest dependency
the lint job runs bun fmt --check
the lint job runs bun lint --type-aware --max-warnings 0 with bunfig.toml's rules; boundaries.test.ts: the rules FR-028 names are errors in bunfig.toml
the release job: the tag matches package.json's version, tsc 7 builds, bun pm pack, the tarball and its SHA-256 attached; boundaries.test.ts: the exports and the build configuration
the pack job installs the packed tarball into an empty project and runs it on Deno, Node and Bun; the release workflow runs the same before releasing
